name: Simulation (mocked): caller changes quantities before confirming
simulation_scenario: Eres el encargado de Abarrotes Doña Lupe, cliente 10234, últimos cuatro dígitos 1234. Pides 'lo de siempre'. Cuando te lean el pedido, cambias de opinión: quieres 5 cajas de refresco en lugar de 3 y quitas las papas. Solo cuando te lo lean corregido, dices 'sí, así'. Luego te despides.
success_condition: The agent read the corrected order back, waited for the caller's explicit 'sí', called create_reorder exactly once with the corrected quantities and without the chips, then gave the folio and delivery date. The create_reorder items must be BEB-010 x5 and ABA-020 x1 only.

mocks.get_usual_order: {"customer_code": "10234", "based_on_orders": 6, "items": [{"sku": "BOT-001", "name": "Papas fritas Crujis sal de mar 45 g", "unit": "caja con 30 bolsas", "typical_quantity": 2, "times_ordered": 6}, {"sku": "BEB-010", "name": "Refresco Nopalia cola 600 ml", "unit": "caja con 24 botellas", "typical_quantity": 3, "times_ordered": 6}, {"sku": "ABA-020", "name": "Frijol bayo Nopalia 1 kg", "unit": "caja con 10 bolsas", "typical_quantity": 1, "times_ordered": 5}]}
